notes.title: Demo release: Dive into the world of our game!
notes.content:
[b]Hello community,[/b]

we are pleased to inform you that the demo version of our game is finally online! From now on you have the opportunity to test the game in advance and see for yourself. This demo gives you the chance to experience the game in its entirety and familiarize yourself with its features, including the multiplayer mode.

You can download the demo directly from Steam and try it out. Use this opportunity to get an idea of our game before you make a purchase decision.

We are looking forward to your feedback and hope that you like the demo. 

So don't hesitate and download the demo now! Have fun playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42687865/94131db9a35be5d545974be56566bf17de4d9925.png[/img]
